meta.name: ai-seo
meta.description: When the user wants to optimize content for AI search engines, get cited by LLMs, or appear in AI-generated answers. Also use when the user mentions 'AI SEO,' 'AEO,' 'GEO,' 'LLMO,' 'answer engine optimization,' 'generative engine optimization,' 'LLM optimization,' 'AI Overviews,' 'optimize for ChatGPT,' 'optimize for Perplexity,' 'AI citations,' 'AI visibility,' 'zero-click search,' 'how do I show up in AI answers,' 'LLM mentions,' 'optimize for Claude/Gemini,' 'llms.txt,' 'OKF,' 'Open Knowledge Format,' 'knowledge bundle,' or 'agent-readable site.' Use this whenever someone wants their content to be cited or surfaced by AI assistants and AI search engines. For traditional technical and on-page SEO audits, see seo-audit. For structured data implementation, see schema.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你分析内容在 AI 搜索中的可见性，并给出优化建议，让内容更容易被 AI 系统引用。
howto.when: 当你提到“AI SEO”、“AEO”、“GEO”、“LLMO”、“优化 ChatGPT 引用”等关键词，或询问如何让内容出现在 AI 回答中时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查我的网站是否被 ChatGPT 引用。
say.note: Claude 会引导你进行 AI 可见性审计。

say.text: 如何优化这篇博客让它在 Perplexity 中被引用？
say.note: Claude 会分析内容结构并提供优化建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will help you analyze your content's visibility in AI search and provide optimization suggestions to make it more likely to be cited by AI systems.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention keywords like 'AI SEO', 'AEO', 'GEO', 'LLMO', 'optimize for ChatGPT', or ask how to appear in AI-generated answers.

say_en.text: Check if my website is cited by ChatGPT.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through an AI visibility audit.

say_en.text: How to optimize this blog post for Perplexity citations?
say_en.note: Claude will analyze content structure and suggest improvements.
